description: What changed since a date, at one company (entity) or across the whole record: every claim that became true, stopped being true, or was first recorded after it. Leads with headline and highlights: the changes that took effect since the date, ranked (leadership, then ownership and deals, then releases; figures and repositories last) and said as a sentence, drawn from the entity's whole record when one is named. Read them first; the rows follow. Claims dated in the future (announced for a later date) are not changes yet and are left out; timeline shows them. limit default 50, max 200; offset pages through the first 900, newest first (the last page is shortened to end there). cursor pages the same feed with no cap, in the order the claims were recorded (oldest first; order: recorded in the answer): pass "" for the first page, then next_cursor from the previous answer; not with offset. assertable_only keeps claims the record asserts for their own dates. Each row carries kind (people, money, products, models or other), the same kinds /changes filters by; kind keeps one: with offset a page is that many changes of the kind and offset counts them; with cursor the filter runs on the page read, so a page can come back short. For one entity's state on two days compared per fact, use entity_diff.

assertable_only.description: Only claims the record asserts for their own dates

cursor.description: Page in recorded order with no cap: "" for the first page, then next_cursor from the previous answer (opaque). Not with offset

detail.description: compact: each row is id, predicate, value, qualifier, the dates it held, status, why_not when the record does not assert it, and the primary source URL: about a fifth the size, so a page holds five times the rows. Left out: published, recorded, confidence, citation, evidence (each is on the claim page, https://asof.is/claim/{id}, or the claim tool). full (the default): every field.

entity.description: Entity slug to keep the changes to, e.g. openai; omit for the whole record

kind.description: Only changes of this kind (lib/change-types.ts, as /changes?type=)

offset.description: Skip this many changes, newest first (next_offset from the previous page); up to 900. Not with cursor

view.description: news: only changes a reader would call news, that the record asserts: leadership, ownership, deals, funding, releases, board and feature changes, the main figures. Left out: Hugging Face repositories, posts, identifiers, routine balance-sheet and quarterly rows, undated claims, and unverified, flagged or retracted ones. For changes_since with an entity, news also means took effect since the date (not merely recorded since), newest first, with total. A news timeline pages by 50 unless limit says otherwise. all (the default): every row.

name: changes_since

claims.description: The changes, each with its kind

complete.description: false when rows remain: ask again with next_offset

headline.description: The changes that took effect, ranked, as one sentence: read it first

legend.description: What the row fields and why_not codes mean

page.description: The page on asof.is that states the same answer

title: Changes since a date
